missing_inputs: No rubric or assessment criteria are supplied.
Anonymity and reviewer roles are unspecified.

timed_sequence.action: Read the two-line description and confirm it is plain text and has two lines.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Point to both lines and note the format.

timed_sequence.action: Record clarity observations limited to wording in the submitted text.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Identify the exact line or phrase.

timed_sequence.action: Record consistency observations limited to relationships within the submitted text.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Identify the relevant lines or phrases.

timed_sequence.action: Ask the author one clarification question and record one text-based revision option; no rubric judgment is made.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Identify the phrase motivating the question or revision.

artifact_checks.check: Confirm the artifact is plain text with two lines.
Note only observable clarity or internal-consistency features; no supplied standard defines pass/fail.

author_questions: Which wording would you clarify or make more internally consistent?
revision_choice: Select one text-based clarity or consistency revision, without treating it as rubric-required.
disagreement_procedure: Quote the submitted wording, state the competing readings, and ask the author or instructor to resolve; do not invent criteria.
completion_check: Confirm the two-line format and that all comments cite text locations and stay within clarity and consistency.
